name: gh_issues_list
description: List issues in a repository with state/assignee/labels filters (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues)

repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

state.description: Indicates the state of the issues to return. Can be either open, closed, or all. Default: open.

assignee.description: Can be the name of a user. Only issues assigned to that user are returned.

creator.description: The user that created the issue.

labels.description: A list of comma separated label names. Example: bug,ui,@high. Issues must have all of the labels.

limit.description: The number of results per page (max 100). GitHub param: per_page. Default: 30.
